message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; it simply lists directory contents and passes paths/images along without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication present in this code slice.

No detected label flipping detection: The code assigns labels based on directory name ('good' = 0, else = 1) with no validation of label distributions, expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset loading code simply reads image paths and assigns labels without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.
No detected model integrity verification: The code uses torchvision's resnet18 and loads checkpoints via glob without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The dataset loading code simply collects image paths and labels without any class balance check, expected-label-set verification, or anomalous sample detection.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While the dataset splits train and test paths separately, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement, and only a single evaluation pass with no independent metric verification.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads images directly from disk paths without any shape, range, or schema validation before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-inference output validation, NaN guards, or probability sanity checks are visible in the provided code slice.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision anomaly detection pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
